sourceTitle: The Oyster: Where, How and When to Find, Breed, Cook and Eat It
description: "The Oyster: Where, How and When to Find, Breed, Cook and Eat It" by Murray is a culinary guide that likely dates back to the mid-19th century. This work dives deep into the world of oysters, detailing their seasonal availability, breeding practices, preparation methods, and culinary significance across different cultures.
